question: Why did the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst with 1.0 wt% rGO reach the highest rate constant for 4-nitrophenol reduction?
rendered: The Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst with 1.0 wt% rGO did not reach the highest rate constant for 4-nitrophenol reduction. According to the excerpts, the highest rate constant (0.8585 min−1) was achieved by the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst with 0.5 wt% rGO.
